property_summary: For every role configured in the constructor (TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE), getRoleAdmin(role) must return the stored admin role TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE; the mutant returns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00) instead, which differs for at least TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE (whose admin is itself, not 0x00).
change_summary: Return the default admin role constant instead of the stored admin role.
